technical.summary: Mixed technical setup with short-term bullish momentum (MACD crossover, Hull flip) offset by price positioning below intermediate moving averages and weak volume confirmation; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MCD shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 15 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (19/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (2 small purchases offset by prior large sale) and absent news sentiment provide weak confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (344.6), strong dollar pressures multinational MCD, CPI event in 1 day adds binary risk, earnings in 15 days compounds volatility.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term technical momentum (MACD crossover, Hull flip, PSAR bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (19/100) creates contrarian entry opportunity near support at 216.14.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), price below both 21-EMA and 50-SMA, weak volume confirmation, high earnings risk in 15 days, and zero fundamental conviction make this a high-risk setup with unfavorable risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear sentiment (19/100) and short-term technical momentum (MACD crossover, Hull flip) present a contrarian setup, severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar) combined with price below key moving averages and weak volume confirmation create unfavorable risk/reward.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 15 days combined with macro recession signals (inverted yield curve, VIX 344.6) could trigger sharp downside move, especially given MCD's multinational exposure to strong dollar headwinds.
